title: June 2026 FDG PET/CT primary report in myUCLAhealth
limitations: Complete three-page native report and authenticated portal capture were reviewed. The prepared public copy removes identifying administrative fields; DICOM images are not represented by this PDF.
Study date and both final signatures are June 11, 2026; signatures are printed at 2:47 PM and 2:58 PM.
Report comparison header and lesion-comparison dates are inconsistent; they are not silently corrected.
The left para-aortic comparison entry ends without an SUV value; no missing comparison value is supplied.
Clinical-history wording contains an uncorroborated procedure phrase; it is not used to add a procedure to the clinical timeline.

limitations: Study date September 8; final joint signatures September 9 and 10.

limitations: Study date December 23; final signatures December 26.

title: Tempus xM / Personalis NeXT Personal Dx amended ctDNA report
limitations: Packet contains two amended-report pages, one blank page and the two-page superseded January 14 report.
Amendment corrects plasma collection from December 19 to December 18, 2025; these represent one specimen and one result.
Amendment sentence literally states amended 2025-02-27; report header and signature state 2026-02-27. The conflict is retained.
PPM is an assay-specific ctDNA fraction and must not be converted to, or plotted as, Signatera MTM/mL.
prepared_report_scope: Amended-report original pages 1 and 2 only; blank page 3 and superseded report pages 4 and 5 omitted.

title: Guardant360 Liquid report on December 2025 blood
limitations: Blood collected December 18, 2025. Tumor fraction below 0.05%; biomarker-negative confidence below 90%.
No reportable somatic alteration with an associated therapy does not mean no variants: the report includes a TRAF2 variant of uncertain significance.

title: Caris Assure report on January 2026 blood
limitations: Blood collected January 27, 2026. Reported tumor fraction 0.0%, blood TMB and MSI indeterminate; low tumor fraction reduces negative-result sensitivity.
Three portal attachment controls reproduce the same report; no three separate specimens or results are inferred.
